title: fix(scripts): read a function-typed property's return type in the ADR-0087 registration gate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_
Fixes #37446

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；变的是公开类型收窄的登记检查，它现在能读懂「属性: (参数) => 返回类型」这种写法的返回类型。
- 为什么做：替靠这道检查拦截公开类型收窄的审查者补上漏洞，之前它会把写了具体返回类型的箭头属性当成没写类型，从而放行一次真实的收窄。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这道检查对某些写法比以前更严，作者会看到一条拒绝信息；改动只在检查脚本里，直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` `memberDefinitionsIn`: a `name: (...) => T` member is now read as a **function type** whose return annotation is the text after the arrow, whenever its `:` sits in a type position: an `interface` or `class` body, a `type` alias object type, an object type nested under one of those through `:` / a union / an intersection / a type argument, or the top level and a parameter list (a `let` / parameter annotation). An object-literal property holding an unannotated arrow (`queryDataset: async (payload) => {`, the founding `type-surface-only` shape), a `name = (...) =>` class field, and anything `async` keep the unannotated reading, so the category's own population is unchanged.
- New helpers beside it: `enclosingOpener`, `sitsInTypePosition`, `braceOpensTypeBody`, `functionTypeReturn`. A container the classifier cannot read falls back to the old value reading.
- Consequence for predicate 4: a concrete arrow-property base (`updateUser: (data: Partial of AuthUser) => Promise of AuthUser`) is now CONCRETE at the merge base, so narrowing it to a method signature or to another arrow property is refused as `narrowed-from-erased is FALSE` instead of admitted.

## Tests

- New self-test pins (battery floors raised to match: `type-surface-only` 26 -> 29, `TSO-U` 30 -> 37):
  - TSO-R8: arrow-property base `Promise` of `AuthUser` -> method-signature head `Promise` of `void` is refused by predicate 4 (the live `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts#updateUser` shape, moved into a published fixture package).
  - TSO-R9: arrow-property -> arrow-property, concrete at both revs, refused.
  - TSO-G2: a truly erased arrow-property base (`=>` `Promise` of `any`) -> method signature is still admitted.
  - TSO-U31..U37: interface / type-literal / class-field function types read their return; a newline-terminated member stops at its line; nested `() => () => T` and a union continued on the next line are read whole; object-literal and `=`-initialised arrows, and `async` arrows, stay unannotated.
- Reproduction before the fix (reader level, on `origin/main` f72f3353): `readDeclaredTypeSurface` on the arrow-property base answered `{"shape":"`updateUser`, which carries NO return annotation","type":null,"erased":true}` and on the method head `{"type":"Promise of void","erased":false}` -- the pair predicate 4 admits.

<details><summary>Self-test and ablation readings</summary>

- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test` at 4f10d40a: `✓ check-adr-0087-registration --self-test: 834 assertions over real temp git repos (real scan()/assertInputs() path)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation (committed fix first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor x1 -> x0, restored blob == HEAD 7b0a4361, `git diff HEAD` empty): disabling the new function-type branch turns red exactly TSO-R8 (`expected RED, got green` -- the permissive admission reproduced end to end through `scan()`), TSO-R9, TSO-U31, U32, U34, U36, U37; TSO-G2, U33, U35 stay green, as they pin the unchanged readings. Lock `VERDICT command-exit 1`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not fixed here, noted: the member head regex does not match an OPTIONAL member (`name?: (...) => T`, `name?(...): T`), so such a symbol reads as "declares no readable symbol" -- a refusal, the strict direction, not this card's permissive one.
- Not fixed here, noted: `braceOpensTypeBody` reads a brace after `:` at the top level as a type, so a top-level ternary `c ? a : { f: (x) => y }` would read `y` as a return type -- the strict direction (a concrete reading refuses predicate 4), and no such shape is a known producer.
- #37445 and #37447 edit the same file and are queued behind this card; neither is touched here.

## Verification

- Read first: `memberDefinitionsIn`'s new `if (!colon)` branch, then `braceOpensTypeBody` (the classifier deciding type vs value), then the TSO-R8 / TSO-G2 pins.
- Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test` -- expect the `✓ ... 834 assertions` line and exit 0.
